set.body:
Goal: build a Scala 3 interpretation of fmrireg-scale functionality without copying the R package surface. Preserve fmrireg as a behavioral oracle, but express the system as typed immutable plans, capability-checked interpreters, chunk programs, and edge adapters.

Design rule: plans are data; engines are interpreters; parallelism is an interpreter; IO is an adapter; invalid analysis states are rejected before execution.

Scope: first-level fit engine extensibility, chunk-program generalization, preprocessing algebra, robust/GLS parity, latent/reduced-rank engines, analysis/job DSL, typed result bundles/export, group/meta extension, and an optional dynamic plugin catalog at JVM/app boundaries.

Acceptance: child slices define and implement the extension spine incrementally, preserve existing JVM/JS behavior, add parity/law tests for each statistical surface, and keep shared code free of mutable registries and JVM-only IO dependencies.
set.title: Epic: Oderskyan fmrireg parity architecture
